correctness.rationale: The proof gives an exact four-vertex width identity in both angular quadrants; the compactly supported cutoff integrals determine uniformly the quadratic and cubic contributions with O_t(epsilon^4) remainder. The standalone direct-vertex verifier passed 203 numerical regressions; these finite tests are supporting evidence, not an infinite proof. Scope excludes degeneracies and global optimization.

value.rationale: This is a sharp two-parameter local structural theorem motivated by the published n=4 width-deviation gap: every rhombus is excluded from local minimization while both diagonal lengths and area are held fixed. The absolute-cubic mixed term exposes two crossover ridges invisible to single-axis kites.
